name: approve-an-agents-request
goal: Approve the benchmark you asked for with a limit you understand, decide the two requests you did not ask for, and know afterwards what you have handed out and how to take it back.
note: Against a throwaway daemon seeded with three waiting requests, two approved, one denied, and keys handed out earlier. Steps that press a button only open a dialog; nothing is submitted.

steps.name: what-is-waiting-for-me
steps.promise: I can see what is waiting for my decision, who asked, and which one is the one I asked for.

steps.name: the-benchmark-before-i-say-yes
steps.promise: Before I approve, I can tell what I am handing out, the most it can spend in dollars, and when it stops by itself.

steps.name: a-request-i-did-not-ask-for
steps.promise: I can tell what this other assistant wants, how much more it could cost me, and for how long.

steps.name: saying-no
steps.promise: I can say no, and the one who asked will be told why.

steps.name: taking-something-back
steps.promise: I can see every key I have handed out, what each has spent against its limit, and switch one off.
